title: Parliament Hill

terrainReference.basis: Original NRCan bare-earth lawn elevation in front of the Centre Block and Peace Tower entrance. Individual building floor heights are approximate.

mapIdentity.scope: Three distinct independent building envelopes with the 32-point Peace Tower on the Centre Block axis and the mapped East Block interior courtyard. The extant Library of Parliament is a separately scheduled building.

note: Official 144 by 75 m Centre Block, 92.2 m Peace Tower and 81 m Mackenzie Tower dimensions. Exact releases resolve the sandstone facades, copper of differing age and tone, narrow roof spires, and the pale clock face. The other wing heights are estimates.
